<cat>gameevent</cat>
<title>achievement_earned</title>

<structure>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<description>
			Called when a player earns an achievement.
	</description>
	<fields>
		<item type="number" name="achievement">The achievement ID.</item>
		<item type="number" name="player">The <page text="UserID">Player:UserID</page> of the player.</item>
	</fields>
</structure>

# Examples
<example>
	<description>This is a basic template with the purpose of including all arguments / table variables to make it easily known which values can be accessed.</description>
	<code>
gameevent.Listen( "achievement_earned" )
hook.Add( "achievement_earned", "achievement_earned_example", function( data )
	local achievement = data.achievement 	-- The achievement ID
	local player = data.player				-- Same as Player:UserID()

	-- Called when a player earns an achievement.
	
end )
	</code>
</example>
